T.past.use.1: Hikoyadagi voqealar ketma-ketligi: I came home, had dinner and went to bed.
T.past.use.2: O'tmishdagi odat: As a child I played football every day.
T.past.vs.0.1: Past Simple — qachon bo'lgani muhim (yesterday, last year). Present Perfect — hozirgi natija muhim, vaqt aytilmaydi: I lost my keys yesterday / I have lost my keys (hozir ham yo'q).
T.past.vs.1.1: Past Simple — harakat to'liq, «nima qildi». Past Continuous — o'tmishning bir lahzasidagi jarayon: I was cooking when he called.
T.pres.use.0: Muntazam harakatlar va odatlar: I drink coffee every morning.
T.pres.use.1: Faktlar va doim to'g'ri bo'lgan narsalar: Water boils at 100 degrees.
T.pres.use.3: He / she / it: darak gapda +s, inkor va so'roqda — does.
T.pres.vs.0.1: Present Simple — odatda, muntazam (I work at a bank). Present Continuous — aynan hozir yoki vaqtincha (I am working from home this week).
T.fut.use.0: Gapirayotgan paytda qabul qilingan qaror: I will help you.

T.fut.use.2: Kelajak haqida taxmin, fikr: I think it will rain.

T.pc.use.2: O'zgarishlar va tendensiyalar: Prices are going up.
T.pc.use.3: Yaqin kelajakka rejalashtirilgan ish: I am meeting Akmal tomorrow.
T.pc.use.4: Holat fe'llari (know, like, want, understand) odatda ‑ing shaklida ishlatilmaydi.
T.pc.vs.0.1: Present Simple — muntazam: He drives to work. Present Continuous — hozir: He is driving now.
T.pc.vs.1.1: Present Continuous — «nima bo'lyapti». Present Perfect Continuous — «qancha vaqtdan beri bo'lyapti»: I have been waiting for an hour.
T.pac.use.0: O'tmishning aniq bir lahzasidagi jarayon: At 8 yesterday I was having dinner.
T.pac.use.1: Qisqa harakat bo'lib qo'ygan fon: I was sleeping when you called. (uzun harakat — Continuous, qisqasi — Past Simple)
T.pac.use.2: Bir vaqtda bo'layotgan ikki jarayon: Mom was cooking while Dad was reading.
T.pac.use.3: I / he / she / it — was, you / we / they — were.
T.pac.vs.0.1: Past Simple — harakat to'liq: I cooked dinner. Past Continuous — jarayonda edi: I was cooking dinner at 7.
T.pp.use.0: Natijasi hozir ham ko'rinib turgan o'tgan harakat: I have lost my keys (hozir ham yo'q).
T.pp.use.1: Hayotiy tajriba, vaqti muhim emas: I have been to Samarkand three times.
T.pp.use.2: Hozirgacha davom etayotgan holat (for / since): I have known him since 2015.
T.pp.use.3: V3 — uchinchi shakl: ‑ed yoki noto'g'ri fe'l (seen, been, done).
T.pp.vs.0.1: Agar tugagan vaqt aytilgan bo'lsa (yesterday, last year, in 2020, ago) — faqat Past Simple: I saw this film last year. Vaqt aytilmagan va natija muhim bo'lsa — Present Perfect: I have seen this film.
T.pp.vs.1.1: Present Perfect — natija, «qancha qildi»: I have read 50 pages. Present Perfect Continuous — jarayon, «qancha vaqtdan beri»: I have been reading for two hours.
T.fc.use.0: Kelajakning aniq bir paytidagi jarayon: At 10 tomorrow I will be working.
T.fc.use.1: Rejalar haqida muloyim savol: Will you be using the car tonight?
T.fc.use.2: Reja bo'yicha o'z-o'zidan bo'ladigan ish: I will be passing the shop anyway.
T.fc.vs.0.1: Future Simple — qaror yoki fakt: I will call you. Future Continuous — «jarayonda bo'laman»: Don't call at 8 — I will be driving.
T.fc.vs.1.1: Future Continuous — kelajak lahzasidagi jarayon. Future Perfect — kelajakdagi paytgacha tugagan bo'ladi: By 10 I will have finished.
T.pap.use.0: «O'tmishdagi o'tmish»: harakat boshqa o'tgan harakatdan oldin bo'lgan: When I came, the film had already started.
T.pap.use.1: O'tmishdagi aniq paytgacha: We had finished by eight o'clock.
T.pap.use.2: Birovning gapini aytib berganda: Akmal said that he had already eaten.
T.pap.vs.0.1: Past Simple — voqealar ketma-ket: The film started, then I came. Past Perfect — biri ikkinchisidan oldin bo'lganini ko'rsatadi: When I came, the film had started.
T.pap.vs.1.1: Past Perfect — o'tmishdagi paytgacha bo'lgan natija. Past Perfect Continuous — o'sha paytgacha qancha davom etgani: I had been waiting for an hour.
T.ppc.use.0: Harakat o'tmishda boshlangan va hozirgacha davom etyapti — «qancha vaqtdan beri» muhim: I have been waiting for an hour.
T.ppc.use.1: Izlari ko'rinib turgan yaqindagi jarayon: Your eyes are red. Have you been crying?
T.ppc.use.2: O'zbek tilida ko'pincha hozirgi zamon: «Bir soatdan beri kutyapman» — ingliz tilida Present Perfect Continuous.
T.ppc.vs.0.1: Present Perfect — natija: I have cleaned the flat (toza). Present Perfect Continuous — jarayon: I have been cleaning all day (charchadim).
T.ppc.vs.1.1: Present Continuous — shunchaki «hozir». Agar «bir soatdan beri / ertalabdan beri / qancha vaqt» bo'lsa — Present Perfect Continuous kerak.
T.fp.use.0: Harakat kelajakdagi paytgacha tugagan bo'ladi: I will have finished by five.
T.fp.use.1: Asosiy belgi so'z — by («...gacha»): by Monday, by then, by the time…
T.fp.use.2: By the time / when / before dan keyingi ergash gapda — Present Simple: by the time you come.
T.fp.vs.0.1: Future Simple — «qilaman»: I will finish the report. Future Perfect — «...gacha qilib bo'lgan bo'laman»: I will have finished it by Friday.
T.fp.vs.1.1: Future Perfect — paytgacha bo'lgan natija. Future Perfect Continuous — o'sha paytgacha qancha davom etgan bo'ladi: By May I will have been working here for a year.

T.papc.vs.0.1: Past Continuous — o'tmish lahzasidagi jarayon: I was waiting when he came. Past Perfect Continuous — o'sha paytgacha qancha davom etgani: I had been waiting for an hour.
T.papc.vs.1.1: Past Perfect — paytgacha bo'lgan natija: I had read the book. Past Perfect Continuous — davomiylik: I had been reading for two hours.
T.fpc.use.0: Kelajakdagi paytgacha harakat qancha davom etgan bo'ladi: Next month I will have been working here for three years.
T.fpc.use.1: Ikkala belgi ham kerak: muddat (for…) va payt (by… / next month / when…).
T.fpc.use.2: Eng kam ishlatiladigan zamon: nutqda asosan «... yildan / soatdan beri» bilan uchraydi.
T.fpc.vs.0.1: Future Perfect — nima qilingan bo'ladi: By May I will have read ten books. Future Perfect Continuous — qancha vaqt: By May I will have been reading for an hour every day for a year.
T.fpc.vs.1.1: Present Perfect Continuous — hozir «bir soatdan beri». Future Perfect Continuous — kelajakdagi paytgacha «bir soat bo'ladi».
TX.pres.tip: Present Simple — bu «odatda, doim, jadval bo'yicha». He / she / it bilan ‑s ni unutmang.
TX.pres.more:
Ingliz tilidagi eng ko'p ishlatiladigan zamon. U bilan o'zingiz, odatlaringiz, ishingiz va faktlar haqida gapirasiz. Harakat hozir bo'layotgan bo'lishi shart emas — muhimi, u muntazam bo'lib turadi.

Darak gapda he / she / it bilan fe'lga ‑s qo'shamiz (s, sh, ch, x, o dan keyin ‑es): works, watches, goes. So'roq va inkorda ‑s does ga «o'tadi», fe'l esa boshlang'ich shaklda qoladi.
TX.pres.err.0.2: He / she / it bilan darak gapda ‑s kerak.
TX.pres.err.1.2: Does / doesn't dan keyin fe'l ‑s siz: qo'shimchani does «yeb qo'ygan».
TX.pres.err.2.2: He / she / it bilan so'roqda — does.
TX.pres.err.3.2: Present Simple da oddiy fe'l bilan am / is / are ishlatilmaydi.
TX.pres.quiz.3.3: Fakt — Present Simple, water = it → boils.
TX.pres.quiz.4.3: Jadval — Present Simple, bus = it → leaves.
TX.past.tip: Past Simple — «qachondir qildi va tamom». Agar yesterday, ago, last… bo'lsa — deyarli aniq shu.
TX.past.more:
O'tmishda tugagan narsa haqida gapiramiz: kecha, o'tgan yili, besh daqiqa oldin. To'g'ri fe'llar ‑ed oladi (worked, played), noto'g'rilarini yodlash kerak (go — went, see — saw, buy — bought).

So'roq va inkorda did ishlaydi, fe'l esa boshlang'ich shaklga qaytadi: Did you see? I didn't see.
TX.past.err.0.2: Did dan keyin — fe'lning birinchi shakli.
TX.past.err.1.2: Did li so'roqda ham fe'l boshlang'ich shaklda.
TX.past.err.2.2: Yesterday, ago, last… bilan — faqat Past Simple.
TX.past.err.3.2: Go — noto'g'ri fe'l: go — went — gone.
TX.past.quiz.3.3: Past Simple da inkor — didn't + fe'l.
TX.past.quiz.4.3: O'tmishdagi odat — Past Simple: drink — drank.
TX.fut.tip: Future Simple — «hozir» qabul qilingan qaror, va'da yoki taxmin. Will — barcha shaxslar uchun.
TX.fut.more:
Will + fe'l — eng oddiy kelasi zamon. Gapirayotgan paytda qaror qilsak (I'll take this one), va'da bersak, yordam taklif qilsak yoki taxmin qilsak (I think it will rain) mos keladi.

Esda tuting: when, if, before, after, as soon as, until dan keyin kelajak haqida Present Simple da gapiriladi: When he comes, I will tell him.
TX.fut.err.0.2: Will dan keyin — to siz fe'l.
TX.fut.err.1.2: Kelajak haqida when / if dan keyin — Present Simple.
TX.fut.quiz.4.3: Kelajak haqida when dan keyin — Present Simple.
TX.pc.tip: Present Continuous — «aynan hozir, jarayonda». Formula: am / is / are + ‑ing li fe'l.
TX.pc.more:
Harakat hozir yoki shu kunlarda bo'layotganini ko'rsatamiz. O'zbekchada «o'qiyapman» va «o'qiyman» farqli, ingliz tilida ham: bu odatmi (Present Simple) yoki hozirgi jarayonmi (Present Continuous)?

Holat fe'llari — know, like, love, want, need, understand, believe — odatda ‑ing shaklida ishlatilmaydi: I know (I am knowing emas).
TX.pc.err.0.2: Am / is / are siz bu gap bo'lmaydi.
TX.pc.err.2.2: Look! — demak aynan hozir: Present Continuous.
TX.pc.quiz.1.3: Bu yilgi vaqtinchalik holat — are building.
TX.pac.tip: Past Continuous — o'tmish lahzasida «jarayonda edi». Uzun harakat — Continuous, qisqasi — Past Simple.
TX.pac.more:
Bu o'tmishning «sekinlashtirilgan tasviri»: biror lahzada harakat davom etayotganini ko'rsatamiz. Ko'pincha u qisqa voqea uchun fon bo'ladi: I was cooking when the phone rang.

Was — I / he / she / it uchun, were — you / we / they uchun.
TX.pac.err.0.2: Was / were dan keyin ‑ing li fe'l kerak.
TX.pac.err.1.2: Qisqa harakat — Past Simple, uzun fon — Past Continuous.
TX.pac.quiz.2.3: Bir vaqtdagi ikki jarayon — ikkalasi ham Past Continuous.
TX.pac.quiz.4.3: Biz chiqqan paytdagi fon — was raining.
TX.pp.tip: Present Perfect — natijasi hozir ko'rinadigan o'tmish. Vaqtni aytmaymiz: yesterday bo'lsa — bu allaqachon Past Simple.
TX.pp.more:
O'tmish va hozirgi zamon orasidagi ko'prik. Harakat bo'lib bo'lgan, lekin bizga hozirgi natija yoki tajriba muhim: I have lost my keys (ular yo'q), I have been to London (qachondir bo'lganman).

Have / has + fe'lning uchinchi shakli (V3): done, seen, been, worked. Belgilar: already, just, yet, ever, never, for, since. Aniq o'tgan vaqt (yesterday, in 2020, ago) u bilan ishlatilmaydi.
TX.pp.err.2.2: Uchinchi shakl kerak: go — went — gone.
TX.fc.tip: Future Continuous — «kelajakning shu lahzasida jarayonda bo'laman»: will be + ‑ing.
TX.fc.more:
Kelajakdagi to'xtatilgan kadrni tasavvur qiling: ertaga soat 10 da nima qilayotgan bo'lasiz? I will be working. Bu zamon natijani emas, jarayonni ko'rsatadi.

U rejalar haqida muloyim so'rash uchun ham ishlatiladi: Will you be using the car tonight? — shunda odamga bosim o'tkazmaymiz.
TX.fc.err.1.2: Kelajakning aniq lahzasidagi jarayon — Future Continuous.
TX.fc.quiz.1.3: Soat 9 da dars bo'layotgan bo'ladi — will be teaching.
TX.fc.quiz.2.3: Rejalar haqida muloyim savol — Will you be…
TX.pap.tip: Past Perfect — «o'tmishdagi o'tmish»: boshqa o'tgan voqeadan oldin nima bo'lgani. Had + V3.
TX.pap.more:
O'tmish haqidagi hikoyada bir harakat undan ham oldin bo'lganini ko'rsatish kerak bo'lsa, had + V3 ishlatamiz: When I came, the film had already started.

Agar voqealar ketma-ket bo'lsa, Past Simple yetadi: I came, and the film started. Past Perfect tartib «teskari» bo'lganda yoki nima oldin bo'lganini ta'kidlash kerak bo'lganda kerak.
TX.pap.err.0.2: Film kelishimizdan oldin boshlangan — had started.
TX.pap.err.2.2: Ikkinchi o'tgan voqea bo'lmasa, Past Perfect kerak emas.
TX.pap.quiz.4.3: Avval kechki ovqat — had had (have dan had + V3).
TX.ppc.tip: Present Perfect Continuous — «qancha vaqtdan beri va hozir ham». «Qancha vaqtdan beri?» savoliga javob.
TX.ppc.more:
Harakat o'tmishda boshlangan va hozir ham davom etyapti (yoki hozirgina tugagan va izlari ko'rinadi). O'zbekchada hozirgi zamonda aytamiz: «Bir soatdan beri kutyapman», ingliz tilida esa — I have been waiting for an hour.

For — vaqt oralig'i (for two hours), since — boshlanish nuqtasi (since morning).
TX.fp.tip: Future Perfect — «shu paytgacha qilib bo'lingan bo'ladi». Asosiy so'z — by.
TX.fp.more:
Kelajakdan orqaga qaraymiz: biror paytgacha harakat allaqachon tugagan bo'ladi. By Friday I will have finished the project.

Belgilar: by 5 o'clock, by tomorrow, by then, by the time… By the time dan keyin kelajak haqida — Present Simple: by the time you come.
TX.fp.err.2.2: By the time dan keyin — Present Simple.
TX.papc.tip: Past Perfect Continuous — «o'tmishdagi o'sha paytgacha uzoq davom etgan». Had been + ‑ing.
TX.papc.more:
Bu o'tmishga surilgan Present Perfect Continuous. O'tmishdagi bir lahzada turib, jarayon qancha vaqtdan beri davom etayotganini aytamiz: I had been waiting for an hour when he finally came.

U o'tmishdagi holatning sababini ham tushuntiradi: Her eyes were red — she had been crying.
TX.papc.err.0.2: «O'sha paytgacha bir soatdan beri» — Past Perfect Continuous.
TX.papc.quiz.3.3: O'tmishdagi jarayon izlari — had been raining.
TX.fpc.tip: Future Perfect Continuous — «o'sha paytga kelib allaqachon shuncha vaqt bo'ladi». Ham muddat, ham payt kerak.
TX.fpc.more:
Eng kam ishlatiladigan zamon. Kelajakdagi paytga kelib harakat qancha davom etgan bo'lishini aytamiz: Next month I will have been working here for three years.

Odatda gapda ham muddat (for three years), ham payt (by May, next month, when…) bo'ladi.
TX.fpc.err.0.2: Kelajakdagi paytgacha muddat — Future Perfect Continuous.
TX.fpc.err.2.2: Have ni yo'qotmang: will have been + ‑ing.
TX.fpc.quiz.1.3: O'sha paytga kelib yo'lda olti soat bo'ladi.
TX.fpc.quiz.2.3: Savol: How long will you have been…
RULES.r1.n: Ko'pchilikdan biri, birinchi marta tilga olinadi
RULES.r1.s: Narsa suhbatda birinchi marta paydo bo'ladi — «qandaydir, bitta». Faqat sanaladigan birlikdagi otlar bilan.
RULES.r1.d: A/an one — «bir» so'zidan kelib chiqqan. Narsa haqida birinchi marta gapirganda yoki qaysi biri ekani muhim bo'lmaganda — ko'pchilikdan istalgani — qo'yamiz. Faqat sanaladigan birlikdagi otlar bilan ishlaydi: a book, lekin a books ham, a water ham emas.
RULES.r1.ex.0: I saw **a** dog in the park. — Parkda (qandaydir) itni ko'rdim.
RULES.r1.ex.2: I need **a** pen. — Menga ruchka kerak (istalgani).
RULES.r2.s: AN — unli tovushdan oldin (an apple, an hour). A — undosh tovushdan oldin (a university, a big apple).
RULES.r2.d: Tanlov keyingi so'zning harfiga emas, birinchi TOVUSHIga bog'liq. Unli tovushdan oldin — an: an apple, an hour (h o'qilmaydi). Undoshdan oldin — a: a university («yu» tovushi), a one-way ticket. Agar sifat bo'lsa, unga qaraymiz: an old car, a big apple.
RULES.r3.s: Odam kim bo'lib ishlashi yoki kimligi haqida gapirganda: She is a doctor.
RULES.r3.d: O'zbekchada «Oyim — shifokor» deymiz, ingliz tilida esa a/an albatta kerak: odam ko'p shifokorlardan biri. Tavsifda ham shunday: He is a kind man. Ko'plikda artikl yo'q: They are doctors.
RULES.r4.s: What a…!, such a…, «...da bir marta» (twice a week), a lot of, a few, a little.
RULES.r4.d: Shunchaki yodlab olinadigan iboralar: what a… (Qanday…!), such a… (shunday…), «...da bir marta»: once a day, three times a week, 60 km an hour; miqdor: a lot of, a few, a little, a couple of.
RULES.r5.s: Narsa haqida avval gapirilgan — endi u «aynan o'sha»: birinchi marta a, keyin the.
RULES.r5.d: The that — «o'sha» so'zidan kelib chiqqan. Narsa haqida avval gapirilgan bo'lsa, ikkinchi marta u ikkalamizga ham tanish: «Kurtka sotib oldim. Kurtka (o'sha) qimmat edi». Birinchi tilga olish — a/an, keyin — the.
RULES.r6.s: Bunday narsa bitta: the sun, the moon, the internet — yoki shu vaziyatda bitta: the door, the kitchen.
RULES.r6.d: Agar narsa dunyoda yagona bo'lsa (the sun, the moon, the sky, the world, the internet) yoki aniq vaziyatda yagona bo'lib, nima haqida gap ketayotgani ikkalamizga ham ayon bo'lsa — the qo'yamiz. «Eshikni yop» — xonada bitta eshik: close the door. «Oyim oshxonada» — uyda bitta oshxona: in the kitchen.
RULES.r7.s: best, biggest, first, last, same, only oldidan — doim the.
RULES.r7.d: Eng yaxshi, birinchi, oxirgi, yagona, aynan o'sha — bunday narsa faqat bitta bo'ladi, shuning uchun the: the best, the most expensive, the first, the last, the same, the only. Diqqat: next week, last year (bugundan hisoblaymiz) — artiklsiz.
RULES.r8.s: So'zdan keyin aniqlik bor: the man in the black jacket, the capital of Uzbekistan, the cake you made.
RULES.r8.d: Agar keyin narsani boshqalaridan ajratib turadigan aniqlik kelsa — of bilan, joy predlogi bilan yoki that / which / who so'zlari bilan — the qo'yamiz: the capital of France, the man in the black jacket, the cake (that) you made.
RULES.r9.s: Daryolar, dengizlar, okeanlar, cho'llar, tog' tizmalari va States / Kingdom / Republic so'zli davlatlar: the USA, the UK, the Aral Sea.
RULES.r9.d: The bilan: daryolar (the Amu Darya, the Thames), dengiz va okeanlar (the Aral Sea, the Pacific Ocean), cho'llar (the Kyzylkum, the Sahara), tog' tizmalari (the Alps, the Tian Shan), «tarkibli» nomli yoki ko'plikdagi davlatlar (the USA, the UK, the UAE, the Netherlands). Artiklsiz: shaharlar, ko'pchilik davlatlar, alohida tog'lar va ko'llar (Tashkent, Uzbekistan, Everest, Lake Issyk-Kul).
RULES.r10.s: play the piano / the guitar, go to the cinema / the theatre, listen to the radio. Lekin: watch TV — artiklsiz.
RULES.r10.d: Musiqa cholg'ulari bilan — the: play the piano, the guitar, the dutar. Dam olish joyi sifatida kino va teatr: go to the cinema, the theatre. Radio — the radio. Istisno: watch TV — artiklsiz.
RULES.r10.ex.2: Dad listens to **the** radio. (lekin: watch TV)
RULES.r11.s: Umuman biror narsa haqida gapirsak — ko'plikda yoki sanalmaydigan (suv, shakar, pul): artikl yo'q.
RULES.r11.d: Narsalar haqida umuman, butun bir tur sifatida gapirganda: I like cats (mushuklarni umuman), Sugar is bad (shakar umuman). Sanalmaydiganlar — water, sugar, money, tea, bread, information, advice, furniture — hech qachon a/an bilan kelmaydi. Lekin aniq bo'lsa — the: The sugar is in the cupboard (uydagi o'sha shakar).
RULES.r12.s: Ismlar, shaharlar, ko'pchilik davlatlar, ko'chalar va tillar — artiklsiz.
RULES.r12.d: Odamlarning ismlari (Akmal, Malika), shaharlar (Tashkent, Samarkand), ko'pchilik davlatlar (Uzbekistan, Russia, China), ko'chalar (Navoi Street), tillar (English, Uzbek) — artiklsiz. Istisnolar — «tarkibli» davlatlar: the USA, the UK («Geografiya» ga qarang).
RULES.r13.s: have breakfast / lunch / dinner, play football, on Monday, in May — artiklsiz.
RULES.r13.d: Ovqatlanishlar (breakfast, lunch, dinner), sport turlari va o'yinlar (football, chess), hafta kunlari, oylar va bayramlar (on Monday, in May, at Navruz) — artiklsiz. Solishtiring: play football (artiklsiz), lekin play the piano (the bilan).
RULES.r14.n: School, work, bed, home, by bus
RULES.r14.s: go to school / work / bed, at home, at night, by bus / metro / car — artiklsiz.
RULES.r14.d: Joy «o'z vazifasi bo'yicha» ishlatilsa, artikl qo'yilmaydi: go to school (o'qish uchun), go to work, go to bed (uxlash uchun), be in hospital (davolanish). Shuningdek: at home, at work, at night, by bus, by car, by metro. Solishtiring: Mom went to the school to talk to the teacher — o'qish uchun emas, binoga borgan.
RULES.r15.n: my, this, some, sonlar va ’s dan keyin
RULES.r15.s: Agar so'zdan oldin my / your / this / that / some / any / no, son yoki kimningdir ’s bo'lsa — artikl kerak emas.
RULES.r15.d: Artikl — bu «aniqlovchi». Agar so'zda boshqa aniqlovchi bo'lsa, ikkinchisi qo'yilmaydi: my car (the my car emas), this book, some water, two apples, Akmal’s phone, no time.
book.seq.tip: Agar asosiy fe'l o'tgan zamonda bo'lsa (said, thought, knew), ikkinchi qismdagi zamon bir qadam orqaga «suriladi».
book.seq.html:
O'zbekchada «U charchaganini aytdi» deymiz va zamonni o'ylab o'tirmaymiz. Ingliz tilida o'tgan zamondagi fe'ldan keyin (said, told, thought, knew, hoped) ergash gapdagi zamon odatda orqaga suriladi.

Edi (to'g'ridan-to'g'ri)Bo'ldi (said dan keyin)
Present Simple: I am tired.Past Simple: He said he was tired.
Present Continuous: I am working.Past Continuous: …he was working.
Present Perfect: I have finished.Past Perfect: …he had finished.
Past Simple: I saw it.Past Perfect: …he had seen it.
will: I will help.would: …he would help.
can / maycould / might

Agar asosiy fe'l hozirgi zamonda bo'lsa (says, thinks), hech narsa surilmaydi: He says he is tired.

Hammaga ma'lum faktlarni surmaslik mumkin: The teacher said that the Earth goes round the Sun.
book.seq.err.0.2: Said dan keyin zamon suriladi: is → was.
book.seq.err.1.2: O'tgan zamondan keyin will → would bo'ladi.
book.questions.tip: So'roq = yordamchi fe'l oldinga. Inkor = not yordamchidan keyin darhol.
book.questions.html:
O'zbekchada so'roqni ‑mi qo'shimchasi bilan beramiz: «Choy ichasanmi?». Ingliz tilida boshida yordamchi fe'l kerak: do, does, did, am / is / are, was / were, have / has, will, can…

(So'roq so'zi) + yordamchi fe'l + ega + fe'l?
Darak gapSo'roqInkor
You like tea.Do you like tea?You don't like tea.
She works here.Does she work here?She doesn't work here.
They went home.Did they go home?They didn't go home.
He is busy.Is he busy?He isn't busy.
We can swim.Can we swim?We can't swim.

So'roq so'zlari

what — nima, who — kim, where — qayerda / qayerga, when — qachon, why — nega, how — qanday, how much / how many — qancha, which — qaysi, whose — kimning.

Agar savol egaga berilsa (kim? nima?), yordamchi fe'l kerak emas: Who called you? What happened?

Qisqa javoblar

Do you speak English? — Yes, I do. / No, I don't. O'sha yordamchi fe'l bilan javob beramiz.
book.questions.err.1.2: Where dan keyin do / does kerak.
book.order.tip: Inglizcha gap poyezdga o'xshaydi: vagonlar qat'iy tartibda turadi. Ega deyarli doim fe'ldan oldin.
book.order.html:
O'zbekchada fe'l odatda gap oxirida keladi: «Men kecha bekatda Akmalni uchratdim». Ingliz tilida tartib qat'iy va boshqacha: fe'l egadan keyin darhol keladi, chunki ma'no so'zning joyiga bog'liq.

Ega + fe'l + to'ldiruvchi + joy + vaqt

I met Akmal at the station yesterday. — Kim? I. Nima qildi? met. Kimni? Akmal. Qayerda? at the station. Qachon? yesterday.

Takrorlanish ravishlari

always, usually, often, sometimes, never oddiy fe'ldan oldin, lekin am / is / are dan keyin qo'yiladi: I often drink tea. She is always late.

Ega shart

O'zbekchada: «Sovuq», «Yomg'ir yog'yapti». Ingliz tilida ega kerak: It is cold. It is raining.

Sifatlar — otdan oldin

a big house, a house big emas.
book.there.s: «Bor» — biror joyda biror narsa bor bo'lganda
book.there.tip: Biror joyda yangi narsa BORligi haqida gapirsak — there is / there are bilan boshlaymiz.
book.there.html:
Biror joyda qandaydir narsa borligini aytganda, inglizcha gap there is / there are bilan boshlanadi. O'zbekcha tarjima odatda joydan boshlanadi: «Xonada stol bor» — There is a table in the room.

Bitta / sanalmaydiganKo'p
+There is a cafe.There are two cafes.
−There isn't any milk.There aren't any chairs.
?Is there a bank near here?Are there any shops?

O'tgan zamon: there was / there were. Kelasi zamon: there will be. Present Perfect: there has been / there have been.

Agar narsa ma'lum bo'lsa va biz uning qayerdaligini aytsak, there kerak emas: The keys are on the table.
book.there.err.0.2: Yangi narsani there is orqali kiritamiz.
book.there.err.3.2: Have bilan adashtirmang: there is / are.
book.articles.s: a / an, the yoki hech narsa
book.articles.tip: A — «qandaydir, ...dan biri», the — «aynan o'sha». O'zbek tilida artikl yo'q, shuning uchun o'zingizdan so'rang: aynan nima haqida gap ketayotgani tushunarlimi?
book.articles.html:
O'zbek va rus tillarida artikl yo'q, shuning uchun ular ortiqchadek tuyuladi. Lekin ingliz uchun artikl muhim belgi: gap qandaydir narsa haqidami yoki aynan o'sha narsa haqida. Artiklsiz ibora qolgani to'g'ri bo'lsa ham «buzuq» eshitiladi.

A / AN«bitta, qandaydir»

one dan kelib chiqqan. Narsa tinglovchi uchun yangi yoki ko'pchilikdan istalgani. Faqat sanaladigan birlikdagi otlar bilan.

I need a pen. — Menga (qandaydir) ruchka kerak.

THE«aynan o'sha»

that dan kelib chiqqan. Qaysi narsa haqida gap ketayotgani ikkalamizga ham tushunarli. Har qanday ot bilan bo'ladi.

Give me the pen. — O'sha ruchkani (stol ustidagini) ber.

—artiklsiz

Ko'plik va sanalmaydigan «umuman», ismlar, shaharlar, tillar, taom, sport, kunlar — va my, this, some allaqachon bo'lsa.

I like pens. Water is life.

Qanday tanlash kerak: tartib bilan 4 ta savol

  1. So'zdan oldin my, your, this, that, some, any, no, son yoki kimningdir ’s bormi?
    → Artikl kerak emas. my car, this bag, two apples, Akmal’s phone
  2. Bu ism, shahar, davlat, til, hafta kuni, oy, ovqatlanish, sportmi?
    → Odatda artiklsiz. Tashkent, English, on Monday, breakfast, football
  3. Tinglovchiga aynan qaysi narsa ekani tushunarlimi? U avval tilga olingan, yagona, aniqlik bor yoki bu «eng / birinchi / oxirgi».
    → the. the sun, the best, the man in black
  4. Yo'q — narsa yangi yoki istalgan.
    → Bitta sanaladigan: a / an. Ko'p yoki sanalmaydigan: artiklsiz. a car → cars → water

A yoki AN?

Keyingi so'zning harfi emas, birinchi tovushi hal qiladi.

AN — unli tovushdan oldinA — undosh tovushdan oldin
an apple, an egga car, a dog
an hour (h o'qilmaydi)a house (h o'qiladi)
an umbrella, an unclea university («yu» tovushi)
an old cara big apple

Barcha qoidalar

Faqat shu qoida bo'yicha topshiriq olish uchun «Mashq qilish» ni bosing.

Juftliklarni solishtiring

ShundayVa shundayFarqi
I have a car.The car is red.birinchi marta → endi bilamiz
I like cats.The cats in our yard are noisy.umuman → aniq
play footballplay the pianosport → cholg'u
go to schoolgo to the schoolo'qish → binoga borish
next weekthe next daybugundan → hikoyadagi voqeadan
book.nouns.tip: Avval so'rang: buni sanash mumkinmi — bitta, ikkita, uchta? Javobga a, many / much va fe'l shakli bog'liq.
book.nouns.html:
Ko'plik

QoidaMisol

s, ss, sh, ch, x, o dan keyin + esbus → buses, watch → watches, box → boxes, tomato → tomatoes
Undosh + y → iescity → cities, baby → babies (lekin day → days)
f / fe → vesknife → knives, leaf → leaves
Maxsus so'zlarman → men, woman → women, child → children, person → people, foot → feet, tooth → teeth, mouse → mice

Sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan

Sanaladiganlarni sanash mumkin: an apple, two apples. Sanalmaydiganlar — moddalar va tushunchalar: water, sugar, money, bread, information, advice, news, furniture, homework. Ularda a / an va ko'plik yo'q, fe'l — it bilandagidek: The news is good.

SanaladiganSanalmaydigan
ko'pmany booksmuch water
oza few booksa little water
qancha?How many books?How much water?
har qanday holatdaa lot of books / a lot of water, some, any

Sanalmaydigan narsani sanash uchun «o'ram» qo'shamiz: a cup of tea, a piece of bread, a bottle of water, a piece of advice.

Qaratqich kelishigi

Akmal’s car — Akmalning mashinasi. ‑s bilan tugagan ko'plikda — faqat apostrof: my parents’ house.
book.pronouns.tip: Bitta «men» ning beshta shakli bor. Ega — I, fe'ldan keyin — me, so'zdan oldin — my, so'zsiz — mine.
book.pronouns.html:
Kim qiladiKimni / kimgaKimning + so'zKimniki (so'zsiz)O'zi
Imemyminemyself

Ega — fe'ldan oldin: She loves him. To'ldiruvchi — fe'l yoki predlogdan keyin: He loves her. Come with me.

my / your otdan oldin turadi: my book. mine / yours uning o'rnini bosadi: This book is mine.

O'zbek tilida «u» erkak uchun ham, ayol uchun ham bitta, ingliz tilida esa he (erkak), she (ayol), it (narsa va hayvon) farqlanadi; they — ko'plikdagi hamma uchun.

Some / any / no

some — darak gapda, any — so'roq va inkorda, no = not any: I have some time. Do you have any time? I have no time. somebody / anybody / nobody, something / anything / nothing bilan ham shunday.
book.pronouns.err.0.2: Ega — I; odob yuzasidan o'zingizni ikkinchi qo'ying.
book.pronouns.err.4.2: Ikki marta inkor qilish mumkin emas.
book.adj.tip: Qisqa so'z — ‑er / ‑est qo'shing. Uzun so'z — more / the most qo'ying. Va eslab qoling: good — better — the best.
book.adj.html:
Ingliz tilida sifatlar jins va son bo'yicha o'zgarmaydi: a big house, big houses, a big car. Ular otdan oldin qo'yiladi.

So'zQiyosiy darajaOrttirma daraja
Qisqa: cheapcheaper (than)the cheapest
‑e bilan: nicenicerthe nicest
Undosh‑unli‑undosh: bigbiggerthe biggest
‑y bilan: happyhappierthe happiest
Uzun: expensivemore expensivethe most expensive
good / bad / farbetter / worse / furtherthe best / the worst / the furthest

than orqali solishtiramiz: Tashkent is bigger than Bukhara. «...dek, ...day» — as … as: He is as tall as his father. «...dek emas» — not as … as.

Bir nechta sifat tartibi: fikr → o'lcham → yosh → rang → material: a beautiful big old red wooden door.

‑ed va ‑ing

I am bored (menga zerikarli) — The film is boring (film zerikarli). ‑ed — men nimani his qilaman, ‑ing — his-tuyg'uni nima uyg'otadi.
book.adv.s: Qanday, qanchalik tez-tez, qayerda va qachon
book.adv.tip: Sifat narsani tasvirlaydi (a quick answer), ravish — harakatni (answer quickly). Ko'pincha bu ‑ly.
book.adv.html:
Ravish qanday? qanchalik tez-tez? qanchalik? savollariga javob beradi va fe'lni, sifatni yoki butun gapni tasvirlaydi.

SifatRavish
slow — sekin (sifat)slowly — sekin (ravish)
carefulcarefully
easyeasily
good — yaxshi (sifat)well — yaxshi (ravish)
fast, hard, late, earlyfast, hard, late, early (o'zgarmaydi)

Ehtiyot bo'ling: hardly = «zo'rg'a», «tirishqoqlik bilan» emas; lately = «so'nggi paytlarda».

Takrorlanish ravishlari

always (doim) → usually → often → sometimes → rarely → never (hech qachon). Fe'ldan oldin, lekin am / is / are dan keyin qo'yiladi: I usually walk. He is never late.

Qiyosiy darajalar

‑ly bilan tugaydigan ravishlar: more slowly, the most carefully. Qisqalari: faster, harder. Maxsuslari: well → better → best, badly → worse → worst.
book.prep.tip: Piramidani tasavvur qiling: at — nuqta, on — sirt, in — katta makon. Vaqt uchun ham xuddi shunday.

at noon, at night

Predlogsiz: today, tomorrow, yesterday, next week, last year, this morning.

for — davomida (for two hours), since — ...dan beri (since Monday), during — vaqtida (during the lesson), by — ...gacha, kechiktirmay (by five), until — ...gacha (until five), ago — oldin, keyin qo'yiladi: two days ago.

Joy

at the bus stop
at home, at work
at the door		on the table
on the wall

Yana: under — ostida, above — ustida (tepasida), next to — yonida, between — (ikkisi) orasida, behind — orqasida, in front of — oldida, opposite — qarshisida, near — yaqinida.

Harakat

to — qayerga (go to school), into — ichiga, from — qayerdan, through — orqali (ichidan), across — orqali (yo'ldan). Lekin: go home — to siz.
book.prep.err.3.2: Go dan keyin home — to siz.
book.modals.s: can, must, should, may, have to
book.modals.tip: Modal fe'ldan keyin — shunchaki fe'l, to siz va ‑s siz: she can swim, he must go.
book.modals.html:
Modal fe'llar harakatga munosabatni ko'rsatadi: qila olaman, kerak, lozim, mumkin. Ular maxsus: shaxsga qarab o'zgarmaydi, so'roqda do olmaydi, ulardan keyin — to siz fe'l.

S + modal fe'l + V (to siz) · So'roq: modal fe'l + S + V?
Fe'lMa'nosiMisol
can / can'tbilaman, qila olaman, mumkinI can swim. Can I come in?
couldqila olardi (o'tmishda), muloyim iltimosCould you help me?
mustshart (o'zim shunday deb hisoblayman), qat'iy qoidaI must call Mom.
mustn'tmumkin emas!You mustn't smoke here.
have tomajburman (vaziyat talab qiladi)I have to work on Saturday.
don't have toshart emasYou don't have to come.

Muhim: mustn't = mumkin emas, don't have to esa = qilmasa ham bo'ladi. O'tmishda must o'rniga had to, can o'rniga — could yoki was able to ishlatiladi.
book.passive.tip: Majhul nisbat — kerakli zamondagi to be + V3. Kim qilgani — by orqali, lekin ko'pincha umuman aytilmaydi.
book.passive.html:
Aniq nisbat: Someone stole my bike. — kim qilgani muhim. Majhul nisbat: My bike was stolen. — narsaga nima bo'lgani muhim. O'zbekchada: «Velosiped o'g'irlandi», «Uy 1990-yilda qurilgan».

To'ldiruvchi + to be (kerakli zamonda) + V3 (+ by …)
ZamonMajhul nisbat
Present SimpleEnglish is spoken here.
Past SimpleThe house was built in 1990.
Future SimpleThe results will be announced tomorrow.
Present ContinuousThe road is being repaired.
Present PerfectMy car has been washed.
modal fe'llar bilanIt must be done today.

Kim qilgani — by orqali: The book was written by Navoi. Bajaruvchi muhim bo'lmasa yoki noma'lum bo'lsa, by kerak emas.
book.passive.err.0.2: to be siz bu majhul nisbat emas.
book.passive.quiz.4.3: Present Continuous Passive — is being + V3.
book.gerund.tip: Ba'zi fe'llardan keyin — ‑ing (enjoy, finish, mind), boshqalaridan keyin — to (want, decide, hope). Ularni fe'l bilan juft qilib o'rganing.
book.gerund.html:
Gerundiy — ot vazifasidagi ‑ing li fe'l: Swimming is good for you. Infinitiv — to + fe'l: I want to swim.

Bulardan keyin — ‑ingBulardan keyin — to + V
enjoy, finish, mind, avoid, keep, stop, miss, practise, suggest, can't standwant, would like, decide, hope, plan, promise, agree, refuse, learn, need

Predloglardan keyin — doim ‑ing: I'm good at drawing. Thank you for helping. I'm interested in learning.

Maqsad «...ish uchun» — to: I went to the shop to buy bread.

Ma'no o'zgaradi

Like, love, hate, start, begin — ikkala usulda ham bo'ladi: I like reading / I like to read.
book.phrasal.s: get up, look for, give up va boshqalar
book.phrasal.tip: Frazali fe'l = fe'l + kichik so'z (up, on, off…). Birgalikda ular yangi ma'no beradi — ularni bitta so'zdek yaxlit o'rganing.
book.phrasal.html:
Kichik yuklama ma'noni butunlay o'zgartiradi: look — qaramoq, look for — qidirmoq, look after — qaramoq (g'amxo'rlik qilmoq). Eng keraklilari:

book.phrasal.err.0.2: Olmosh bilan — fe'l va yuklama o'rtasida.
book.usedto.s: Avval qanday edi, endi esa unday emas
book.usedto.tip: Used to + fe'l — «avval shunday edi, endi esa yo'q». Faqat o'tmish haqida!
book.usedto.html:
Used to o'tmishdagi, endi yo'q bo'lgan odat va holatlar haqida gapiradi: I used to live in Samarkand (endi boshqa joyda yashayman).

+I used to play football.
−I didn't use to like coffee.
?Did you use to wear glasses?

So'roq va inkorda use to (d siz) yoziladi, chunki o'tmishni did allaqachon ko'rsatadi.

Adashtirmang

be used to + ‑ing — «...ga o'rgangan»: I am used to getting up early.

get used to + ‑ing — «...ga o'rganmoq»: I'm getting used to the cold weather.

Hozirgi odatlar uchun used to ishlatilmaydi — usually bilan Present Simple ishlatamiz: I usually drink tea.
book.usedto.err.3.2: Hozirgi zamon haqida used to aytilmaydi.
book.cond.tip: Turi buning qanchalik real ekaniga bog'liq: doim (0), mumkin (1), orzu (2), allaqachon kech (3).
book.cond.html:
TuriAgar (if)UndaMa'nosi
0Present SimplePresent Simpledoim shunday, fakt
1Present Simplewill + Vkelajakda real
2Past Simplewould + Vhozir noreal, orzu
3Past Perfectwould have + V3o'tmishda noreal, afsus

0: If you heat ice, it melts. — Muzni isitsangiz, u eriydi.

1: If it rains, we will stay at home. — Agar yomg'ir yog'sa, uyda qolamiz. If dan keyin — hech qanday will yo'q.

2: If I had a lot of money, I would buy a house. — Pulim ko'p bo'lganida, uy sotib olardim. Be bilan ko'pincha hamma uchun were yoziladi: If I were you…

3: If I had studied, I would have passed the exam. — O'qiganimda, imtihondan o'tgan bo'lardim (lekin o'qimadim va o'tmadim).

Qismlarning o'rnini almashtirish mumkin; if boshida tursa, vergul kerak.
book.reported.tip: Aytib berayotganda — zamonni bir qadam orqaga suramiz, «men» ni «u» ga, «bu yerda» ni «u yerda» ga almashtiramiz.
book.reported.html:
Ko'chirma gap: Akmal said, "I am tired." O'zlashtirma gap: Akmal said (that) he was tired.

Kirish fe'li o'tgan zamonda bo'lsa (said, told), zamon «Zamonlar moslashuvi» bobidagidek suriladi: am → was, will → would, have done → had done, did → had done.

Yana nimalar o'zgaradi

Ko'chirma gapO'zlashtirma gap
I, myhe / she, his / her
nowthen
todaythat day
yesterdaythe day before
tomorrowthe next day
here, thisthere, that

Say yoki tell?

say — «kimga» siz: He said that… tell — albatta kimga: He told me that…

Savollar va iltimoslar

Savol do / did siz darak gapga aylanadi: "Where do you live?" → She asked where I lived. Ha / yo'q savollari — if orqali: He asked if I was busy.

Iltimos va buyruqlar — to orqali: "Close the door." → She asked me to close the door. "Don't shout." → He told us not to shout.
book.reported.err.1.2: O'zlashtirma savolda did ham, teskari tartib ham yo'q.
book.wish.tip: Wish zamonni doim orqaga «suradi»: hozirgi haqida — Past Simple, o'tmish haqida — Past Perfect.
book.wish.html:
Wish afsus yoki orzuni ifodalaydi. O'zbekcha «Qani endi …sam» va «Afsuski, …» ingliz tilida zamon surilgan wish orqali tuziladi.

Nimadan afsuslanamizFormulaMisol
hozirgi haqidawish + Past SimpleI wish I knew the answer. — Qani endi javobni bilsam.
o'tmish haqidawish + Past PerfectI wish I had studied more. — Afsuski, kam o'qiganman.
birovning xatti-harakati, g'ashlikwish + wouldI wish you would stop talking. — Qani endi jim bo'lsang.
qobiliyatwish + couldI wish I could swim. — Qani endi suzishni bilsam.

Be bilan barcha shaxslar uchun were bo'ladi: I wish I were taller.

E'tibor bering: ma'no teskari — o'zbekchada «bilmayman», inglizchada esa darak gap I wish I knew.

If only — xuddi shunday, faqat hissiyotliroq: If only I had more time!

12 ta zamon faqat nomi bilan qo'rqitadi. Aslida bu jadval: 3 ta payt (Past, Present, Future) × harakatning 4 ta turi.

Ularni yo'l bo'ylab — oddiydan murakkabga o'rgangan ma'qul. Bosh ekranda yo'lning har bir bekati mashq va bobni ochadi.

Belgilar

S — ega (I, you, he…). V — fe'lning boshlang'ich shakli. V2 — ikkinchi shakl, V3 — uchinchi shakl (‑ed yoki noto'g'ri fe'l: go — went — gone). V‑ing — ‑ing qo'shimchali fe'l.
OVERVIEW.err.0.2: Am / is / are oddiy fe'l bilan ‑ing siz ishlatilmaydi.
OVERVIEW.err.2.2: Kelajak haqida when / if dan keyin — Present Simple.
